sources.title: The oldest fossil mushroom
sources.supports: Cretaceous mineralized gilled mushroom cap and stalk.
sources.license: Consulted only, no reference media/meshes incorporated
sources.notes: Read basic-form evidence; no exact specimen reproduction. Fossil lies flat on slab, not upright living mushroom. Cap width .010 m versus stalk length .034 m follows paper basic proportions. Slab and .002 m relief thickness illustrative; original color unknown. Concept B overly wide cap and upright appearance rejected.
